critique: The coral’s timed forking and gradual shift from parchment neutrals into salmon and ochre make growth legible and joyful, while the pale aqua wash, sfumato-like recession, and centered seabed passage sustain the requested high-key perspective. The overt ruled floor grid and tiny unrelated guinea-pig icon undermine the Renaissance illusion; subtler converging seabed contours and removal of the mascot would better unify the classical underwater space.
